observations: InternalMethodsImpl default context first delegates custom context validity/server/target-level/physical-waystone checks, resolves destination, then mode/leashed list/fromwaystone/helditem/cooldown/xp. The getter/physical directory details and API binding/callers were not expanded; old directory/player-discovery migration owners remain0.

WaystoneTeleportContext stores mutable destination plus final logical targetWaystone. isDimensionalTeleport compares logical target dimension against entity current dimension, not mutable destination. Pre exposes context, redirects destination/additional entities/xp/cooldown and two result overrides. No specific event listener or native EventResult/dispatcher semantics verified, so no current bypass assertion.

PlayerWaystoneManager.tryTeleport fires Pre, returns typed canceled error if flagged, then validates mode, target-mode predicate, dimensional permission and entire leashed-list restriction/type blacklist/dimensional transport, then primary player XP. A disallowed leash blocks this whole own attempt before own item/cooldown/xp calls. Predicate names/constants/group size not independent policy credits.

After local gates, optional item shrink happens first using event consume result/default creative+context rule, then primary-player cooldown and XP calls, then doTeleport, Post and Either.left(list). Errors carry selected translation keys; NotOnServer/InvalidDimension/InvalidWaystone/CancelledByEvent/WarpModeRejected/NotEnoughXp have no key. informRejectedTeleport logs every error and only sends red non-actionbar player text when key nonnull; no throttling or final receipt proven.

doTeleport invokes teleportEntityAndAttached for primary then each additional entity using same context. Each group separately teleports mount, every shared leashed entity, then root; appends returned objects and re-leashes Mob objects to returned root. No remount, own per-member success ledger, dedup or rollback. Additional roots can reuse the same leashed list; native removed-object/crossworld behavior unknown.

Nonplayer cross-dimension path unRide then create new type; null creation returns original entity unchanged. That returned original is still appended to nominal teleportedEntities. Successful creation restores/moves new, removes old and calls addDuringTeleport without verifying final world delivery here. Server-player path requests connection.teleport or teleportTo, stops riding/sleep, then returns object. Root success result and output list are not proof every member arrived.

Only after teleport loops, doTeleport reads context original entity level/blockpos as source anchor. Same-world mutation or different identity path can therefore affect that anchor; not a captured pre-move origin. It marks target warpplate cooldown for returned objects, requests both sounds and source effect per returned object plus one target effect. Whether actual source/target visuals duplicate or land wrongly was not run.

Non-fallflying returned entities get vertical motion zero and onGround true; pathfinder navigation stops; player XP packet requested after teleport. These setters/packet request not control-success or invulnerability evidence. WarpDamageResetHandler stops use for player holding IResetUseOnDamage when receiving LivingDamageEvent; registration, stage and positive/final damage result are not expanded, so no new channel-interruption policy.

Whole core methods187-534 were read, but manager1-186/535-596, exact native producer/network selection, concrete event bus/result consumer, target resolution/warpplate/helper/client effect chain remain unexpanded. InternalMethods other placement APIs were read as containing-file context only, not building design or credited research.

semantic_decision: No complete new related whole policy established in this bounded screen. ArsExchange already owns per-recipient non-atomic multi-target relocation; Botania owns destination interception and paid attempt without arrival proof; TConstruct owns partial effects/fees surviving final teleport denial. Waystones observed list-wide leash gates, upfront fee, copied/original returned entity list and post-cue do not by themselves justify splitting constants/attachments/defects into an independent reference. Do not assert every possible Waystones implementation overlaps: native producers/event and feedback chain are unexpanded. Preserve this scope0 and move to a different existing source.
